symptom: Pluggable widget `Selection` BSON value is lowercase (`single` / `multi` / `none`) but Studio Pro stores PascalCase — contributes to CE0463 drift on stricter widgets and looks wrong in diffs
cause: MDL passes the user's typed value verbatim to `SetSelection`; the builder didn't normalise
insight: Canonicalise via `canonicalSelectionValue` helper (lowercase-keyed switch → `Single` / `Multi` / `None`); unknown values pass through
